reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1944 a, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ تَوْبَةَ الْعَنْبَرِيِّ، سَمِعَ الشَّعْبِيَّ، سَمِعَ ابْنَ عُمَرَ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ مَعَهُ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ فِيهِمْ سَعْدٌ وَأُتُوا بِلَحْمِ ضَبٍّ فَنَادَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنْ نِسَاءِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِنَّهُ لَحْمُ ضَبٍّ فَقَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ كُلُوا فَإِنَّهُ حَلاَلٌ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَيْسَ مِنْ طَعَامِي ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh narrated to us: my father narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Tawbah al-'Anbari, who heard ash-Sha'bi, who heard Ibn 'Umar: that some people among the companions of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), among whom was Sa'd, were with him, and meat of mastigure was brought to them. Then one of the wives of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) called out: 'It is mastigure meat.' The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'Eat, for it is lawful, but it is not of my food.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1944 b, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ تَوْبَةَ الْعَنْبَرِيِّ، قَالَ قَالَ لِي الشَّعْبِيُّ أَرَأَيْتَ حَدِيثَ الْحَسَنِ عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَقَاعَدْتُ ابْنَ عُمَرَ قَرِيبًا مِنْ سَنَتَيْنِ أَوْ سَنَةٍ وَنِصْفٍ فَلَمْ أَسْمَعْهُ رَوَى عَنِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم غَيْرَ هَذَا قَالَ كَانَ نَاسٌ مِنْ أَصْحَابِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِيهِمْ سَعْدٌ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ مُعَاذٍ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Tawbah al-'Anbari, who said: ash-Sha'bi said to me: 'Have you considered the hadith of al-Hasan from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)? Yet I sat with Ibn 'Umar for nearly two years, or a year and a half, and I did not hear him narrate from the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) other than this.' He said: 'There were people among the companions of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), among whom was Sa'd...' with the like of the hadith of Mu'adh.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1945 a, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، قَالَ قَرَأْتُ عَلَى مَالِكٍ عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ، بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ دَخَلْتُ أَنَا وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ، مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْتَ مَيْمُونَةَ فَأُتِيَ بِضَبٍّ مَحْنُوذٍ فَأَهْوَى إِلَيْهِ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِيَدِهِ فَقَالَ بَعْضُ النِّسْوَةِ اللاَّتِي فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ أَخْبِرُوا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَا يُرِيدُ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ فَقُلْتُ أَحَرَامٌ هُوَ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ خَالِدٌ فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْظُرُ ‏.‏
en_text: Yahya ibn Yahya narrated to us, saying: I recited to Malik, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf, from 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas, who said: Khalid ibn al-Walid and I entered with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) the house of Maymunah, and a roasted mastigure was brought. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) reached out his hand towards it, whereupon some of the women in Maymunah's house said: 'Inform the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) what he intends to eat.' So the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) raised his hand. I said: 'Is it unlawful, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'No, but it was not in the land of my people, so I find that I have a distaste for it.' Khalid said: 'So I pulled it towards myself and ate it while the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was looking on.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1945 b, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، أَخْبَرَنَا مَعْمَرٌ، عَنِ الزُّهْرِيِّ، عَنْ أَبِي، أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، قَالَ أُتِيَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَنَحْنُ فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ بِضَبَّيْنِ مَشْوِيَّيْنِ ‏.‏ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِهِمْ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ يَزِيدَ بْنَ الأَصَمِّ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us: 'Abd ar-Razzaq reported to us: Ma'mar reported to us, from az-Zuhri, from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf, from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: Two roasted mastigures were brought to the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) while we were in the house of Maymunah. With the like of their hadith, and he did not mention Yazid ibn al-Asamm from Maymunah.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1945 c, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ الْمَلِكِ بْنُ شُعَيْبِ بْنِ اللَّيْثِ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ جَدِّي، حَدَّثَنِي خَالِدُ بْنُ، يَزِيدَ حَدَّثَنِي سَعِيدُ بْنُ أَبِي هِلاَلٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ الْمُنْكَدِرِ، أَنَّ أَبَا أُمَامَةَ بْنَ سَهْلٍ، أَخْبَرَهُ عَنِ ابْنِ، عَبَّاسٍ قَالَ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهُوَ فِي بَيْتِ مَيْمُونَةَ وَعِنْدَهُ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ بِلَحْمِ ضَبٍّ ‏.‏ فَذَكَرَ بِمَعْنَى حَدِيثِ الزُّهْرِيِّ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Abd al-Malik ibn Shu'ayb ibn al-Layth narrated to us: my father narrated to us, from my grandfather: Khalid ibn Yazid narrated to me: Sa'id ibn Abi Hilal narrated to me, from Ibn al-Munkadir: that Abu Umamah ibn Sahl informed him from Ibn 'Abbas, who said: Mastigure meat was brought to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) while he was in the house of Maymunah, and Khalid ibn al-Walid was with him. Then he mentioned the meaning of the hadith of az-Zuhri.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1946 a, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو الطَّاهِرِ، وَحَرْمَلَةُ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ وَهْبٍ، قَالَ حَرْمَلَةُ أَخْبَرَنَا ابْنُ وَهْبٍ، أَخْبَرَنِي يُونُسُ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلِ بْنِ حُنَيْفٍ الأَنْصَارِيِّ، أَنَّ عَبْدَ اللَّهِ، بْنَ عَبَّاسٍ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ الَّذِي يُقَالُ لَهُ سَيْفُ اللَّهِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ زَوْجِ النَّبِيِّ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَهِيَ خَالَتُهُ وَخَالَةُ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ فَوَجَدَ عِنْدَهَا ضَبًّا مَحْنُوذًا قَدِمَتْ بِهِ أُخْتُهَا حُفَيْدَةُ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ مِنْ نَجْدٍ فَقَدَّمَتِ الضَّبَّ لِرَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَكَانَ قَلَّمَا يُقَدَّمُ إِلَيْهِ طَعَامٌ حَتَّى يُحَدَّثَ بِهِ وَيُسَمَّى لَهُ فَأَهْوَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ إِلَى الضَّبِّ فَقَالَتِ امْرَأَةٌ مِنَ النِّسْوَةِ الْحُضُورِ أَخْبِرْنَ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِمَا قَدَّمْتُنَّ لَهُ ‏.‏ قُلْنَ هُوَ الضَّبُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ ‏.‏ فَرَفَعَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَدَهُ فَقَالَ خَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ أَحَرَامٌ الضَّبُّ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ وَلَكِنَّهُ لَمْ يَكُنْ بِأَرْضِ قَوْمِي فَأَجِدُنِي أَعَافُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ خَالِدٌ فَاجْتَرَرْتُهُ فَأَكَلْتُهُ وَرَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم يَنْظُرُ فَلَمْ يَنْهَنِي ‏.‏
en_text: Abu at-Tahir and Harmalah both narrated to me from Ibn Wahb—Harmalah said: Ibn Wahb reported to us: Yunus informed me, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl ibn Hunayf al-Ansari: that 'Abdullah ibn 'Abbas informed him that Khalid ibn al-Walid—who is called the Sword of Allah—informed him that he entered with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) upon Maymunah, wife of the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and she was his maternal aunt and maternal aunt of Ibn 'Abbas. He found with her a roasted mastigure which her sister Hufaydah bint al-Harith had brought from Najd. She presented the mastigure to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace)—and food was seldom presented to him without it being described and named for him. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) reached out his hand towards the mastigure, whereupon one of the women present said: 'Inform the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) of what you have presented to him.' They said: 'It is mastigure, O Messenger of Allah.' The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) raised his hand, so Khalid ibn al-Walid asked: 'Is mastigure unlawful, O Messenger of Allah?' He said: 'No, but it was not in the land of my people, so I find that I have a distaste for it.' Khalid said: 'So I pulled it towards myself and ate it while the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was looking on, and he did not forbid me.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1946 b, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ النَّضْرِ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالَ عَبْدٌ أَخْبَرَنِي وَقَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَعْقُوبُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ بْنِ سَعْدٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، عَنْ صَالِحِ بْنِ كَيْسَانَ، عَنِ ابْنِ شِهَابٍ، عَنْ أَبِي، أُمَامَةَ بْنِ سَهْلٍ عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّهُ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّ خَالِدَ بْنَ الْوَلِيدِ أَخْبَرَهُ أَنَّهُ، دَخَلَ مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَلَى مَيْمُونَةَ بِنْتِ الْحَارِثِ وَهْىَ خَالَتُهُ فَقُدِّمَ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَحْمُ ضَبٍّ جَاءَتْ بِهِ أُمُّ حُفَيْدٍ بِنْتُ الْحَارِثِ مِنْ نَجْدٍ وَكَانَتْ تَحْتَ رَجُلٍ مِنْ بَنِي جَعْفَرٍ وَكَانَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لاَ يَأْكُلُ شَيْئًا حَتَّى يَعْلَمَ مَا هُوَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ ذَكَرَ بِمِثْلِ حَدِيثِ يُونُسَ وَزَادَ فِي آخِرِ الْحَدِيثِ وَحَدَّثَهُ ابْنُ الأَصَمِّ عَنْ مَيْمُونَةَ وَكَانَ فِي حَجْرِهَا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn an-Nadr and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to me—'Abd said: he reported to me, and Abu Bakr said: Ya'qub ibn Ibrahim ibn Sa'd narrated to us: my father narrated to us, from Salih ibn Kaysan, from Ibn Shihab, from Abu Umamah ibn Sahl, from Ibn 'Abbas: that he informed him that Khalid ibn al-Walid informed him that he entered with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) upon Maymunah bint al-Harith, and she was his maternal aunt. Meat of mastigure was presented to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), which Umm Hufayd bint al-Harith had brought from Najd—and she was married to a man from Banu Ja'far—and the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) would rarely eat anything until he knew what it was. Then he mentioned the like of the hadith of Yunus, and added at the end of the hadith: and Ibn al-Asamm narrated it from Maymunah, and he was under her guardianship.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1947, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، وَأَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ قَالَ ابْنُ نَافِعٍ أَخْبَرَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ، يَقُولُ أَهْدَتْ خَالَتِي أُمُّ حُفَيْدٍ إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَمْنًا وَأَقِطًا وَأَضُبًّا فَأَكَلَ مِنَ السَّمْنِ وَالأَقِطِ وَتَرَكَ الضَّبَّ تَقَذُّرًا وَأُكِلَ عَلَى مَائِدَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم وَلَوْ كَانَ حَرَامًا مَا أُكِلَ عَلَى مَائِدَةِ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Bashshar and Abu Bakr ibn Nafi' narrated to us—Ibn Nafi' said: Ghundar reported to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said: I heard Ibn 'Abbas saying: My maternal aunt Umm Hufayd gifted clarified butter (ghee), dried curd (iqit), and mastigures to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). He ate from the clarified butter and dried curd, and left the mastigures out of personal distaste; and they were eaten at the table of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and had it been unlawful, it would not have been eaten at the table of the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace).

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1948, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا عَلِيُّ بْنُ مُسْهِرٍ، عَنِ الشَّيْبَانِيِّ، عَنْ يَزِيدَ بْنِ، الأَصَمِّ قَالَ دَعَانَا عَرُوسٌ بِالْمَدِينَةِ فَقَرَّبَ إِلَيْنَا ثَلاَثَةَ عَشَرَ ضَبًّا فَآكِلٌ وَتَارِكٌ فَلَقِيتُ ابْنَ عَبَّاسٍ مِنَ الْغَدِ فَأَخْبَرْتُهُ فَأَكْثَرَ الْقَوْمُ حَوْلَهُ حَتَّى قَالَ بَعْضُهُمْ قَالَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏"‏ لاَ آكُلُهُ وَلاَ أَنْهَى عَنْهُ وَلاَ أُحَرِّمُهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عَبَّاسٍ بِئْسَ مَا قُلْتُمْ مَا بُعِثَ نَبِيُّ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم إِلاَّ مُحِلاًّ وَمُحَرِّمًا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بَيْنَمَا هُوَ عِنْدَ مَيْمُونَةَ وَعِنْدَهُ الْفَضْلُ بْنُ عَبَّاسٍ وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ وَامْرَأَةٌ أُخْرَى إِذْ قُرِّبَ إِلَيْهِمْ خِوَانٌ عَلَيْهِ لَحْمٌ فَلَمَّا أَرَادَ النَّبِيُّ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ يَأْكُلَ قَالَتْ لَهُ مَيْمُونَةُ إِنَّهُ لَحْمُ ضَبٍّ ‏.‏ فَكَفَّ يَدَهُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ هَذَا لَحْمٌ لَمْ آكُلْهُ قَطُّ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ لَهُمْ ‏"‏ كُلُوا ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَأَكَلَ مِنْهُ الْفَضْلُ وَخَالِدُ بْنُ الْوَلِيدِ وَالْمَرْأَةُ ‏.‏ وَقَالَتْ مَيْمُونَةُ لاَ آكُلُ مِنْ شَىْءٍ إِلاَّ شَىْءٌ يَأْكُلُ مِنْهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: 'Ali ibn Mushir narrated to us, from ash-Shaybani, from Yazid ibn al-Asamm, who said: A newly married man invited us in Medina and served us thirteen mastigures; some ate and some refrained. The next day, I met Ibn 'Abbas and informed him, and the people around him began to talk a lot until some of them said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'I neither eat it, nor do I forbid it, nor do I declare it unlawful.' Ibn 'Abbas said: 'How evil is what you have said! The Prophet of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was sent only to declare lawful and unlawful. While the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was with Maymunah, and with him were al-Fadl ibn 'Abbas, Khalid ibn al-Walid, and another woman, a dining table with meat on it was brought to them. When the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) was about to eat, Maymunah said to him: 'It is mastigure meat.' So he withdrew his hand and said: 'This is meat that I have never eaten.' And he said to them: 'Eat.' So al-Fadl, Khalid ibn al-Walid, and the woman ate from it. And Maymunah said: 'I will not eat from anything except what the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) eats from.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1949, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَعَبْدُ بْنُ حُمَيْدٍ، قَالاَ أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الرَّزَّاقِ، عَنِ ابْنِ، جُرَيْجٍ أَخْبَرَنِي أَبُو الزُّبَيْرِ، أَنَّهُ سَمِعَ جَابِرَ بْنَ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ، يَقُولُ أُتِيَ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم بِضَبٍّ فَأَبَى أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْهُ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّهُ مِنَ الْقُرُونِ الَّتِي مُسِخَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Ishaq ibn Ibrahim and 'Abd ibn Humayd narrated to us, saying: 'Abd ar-Razzaq reported to us, from Ibn Jurayj: Abu az-Zubayr informed me that he heard Jabir ibn 'Abdullah saying: A mastigure (spiny-tailed lizard) was brought to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), but he refused to eat from it, saying: 'I do not know; perhaps it is from the generations that were transformed.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1950, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي سَلَمَةُ بْنُ شَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا الْحَسَنُ بْنُ أَعْيَنَ، حَدَّثَنَا مَعْقِلٌ، عَنْ أَبِي الزُّبَيْرِ، قَالَ سَأَلْتُ جَابِرًا عَنِ الضَّبِّ، فَقَالَ لاَ تَطْعَمُوهُ ‏.‏ وَقَذِرَهُ وَقَالَ قَالَ عُمَرُ بْنُ الْخَطَّابِ إِنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَمْ يُحَرِّمْهُ ‏.‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ يَنْفَعُ بِهِ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ فَإِنَّمَا طَعَامُ عَامَّةِ الرِّعَاءِ مِنْهُ وَلَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي طَعِمْتُهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Salamah ibn Shabib narrated to me: al-Hasan ibn A'yan narrated to us: Ma'qil narrated to us, from Abu az-Zubayr, who said: I asked Jabir about the mastigure (spiny-tailed lizard), and he said: 'Do not eat it,' and he found it repulsive. And he said: 'Umar ibn al-Khattab said: 'The Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) did not forbid it. Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, brings benefit through it to more than one person, and indeed it is the food of most of the shepherds; and if I had some with me, I would have eaten it.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1951 a, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ دَاوُدَ، عَنْ أَبِي نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، قَالَ قَالَ رَجُلٌ يَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ إِنَّا بِأَرْضٍ مَضَبَّةٍ فَمَا تَأْمُرُنَا أَوْ فَمَا تُفْتِينَا قَالَ ‏"‏ ذُكِرَ لِي أَنَّ أُمَّةً مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ مُسِخَتْ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ فَلَمْ يَأْمُرْ وَلَمْ يَنْهَ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو سَعِيدٍ فَلَمَّا كَانَ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ قَالَ عُمَرُ إِنَّ اللَّهَ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ لَيَنْفَعُ بِهِ غَيْرَ وَاحِدٍ وَإِنَّهُ لَطَعَامُ عَامَّةِ هَذِهِ الرِّعَاءِ وَلَوْ كَانَ عِنْدِي لَطَعِمْتُهُ إِنَّمَا عَافَهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to me: Ibn Abi 'Adi narrated to us, from Dawud, from Abu Nadrah, from Abu Sa'id, who said: A man said: 'O Messenger of Allah, we are in a land abundant with mastigures (spiny-tailed lizards); what do you command us, or what ruling do you give us?' He said: 'It was mentioned to me that a community from the Children of Israel was transformed.' So he neither commanded nor forbade. Abu Sa'id said: Sometime after that, 'Umar said: 'Indeed Allah, Mighty and Majestic, brings benefit through it to more than one person, and it is the staple food of most of these shepherds; and if I had some with me, I would have eaten it. The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) only felt a distaste for it.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1951 b, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الضَّبِّ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ حَاتِمٍ، حَدَّثَنَا بَهْزٌ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَقِيلٍ الدَّوْرَقِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو نَضْرَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي سَعِيدٍ، أَنَّ أَعْرَابِيًّا، أَتَى رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَالَ إِنِّي فِي غَائِطٍ مَضَبَّةٍ وَإِنَّهُ عَامَّةُ طَعَامِ أَهْلِي - قَالَ - فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ فَقُلْنَا عَاوِدْهُ ‏.‏ فَعَاوَدَهُ فَلَمْ يُجِبْهُ ثَلاَثًا ثُمَّ نَادَاهُ رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فِي الثَّالِثَةِ فَقَالَ ‏"‏ يَا أَعْرَابِيُّ إِنَّ اللَّهَ لَعَنَ أَوْ غَضِبَ عَلَى سِبْطٍ مِنْ بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ فَمَسَخَهُمْ دَوَابَّ يَدِبُّونَ فِي الأَرْضِ فَلاَ أَدْرِي لَعَلَّ هَذَا مِنْهَا فَلَسْتُ آكُلُهَا وَلاَ أَنْهَى عَنْهَا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn Hatim narrated to me: Bahz narrated to us: Abu 'Aqil ad-Dawraqi narrated to us: Abu Nadrah narrated to us, from Abu Sa'id: that a Bedouin came to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) and said: 'I live in a low ground full of mastigures (spiny-tailed lizards), and they are the staple food of my family.' He said: But he did not answer him. So we said: 'Ask him again.' He asked him again, but he did not answer him three times. Then the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) called out to him on the third time, saying: 'O Bedouin, indeed Allah cursed—or became angry with—a tribe of the Children of Israel, and transformed them into beasts creeping upon the earth. I do not know, perhaps this is among them; so I do not eat it, nor do I forbid it.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1952 a, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الْجَرَادِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كَامِلٍ الْجَحْدَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ، أَبِي أَوْفَى قَالَ غَزَوْنَا مَعَ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ نَأْكُلُ الْجَرَادَ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Kamil al-Jahdari narrated to us: Abu 'Awanah narrated to us, from Abu Ya'fur, from 'Abdullah ibn Abi Awfa, who said: We went on seven military expeditions with the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), eating locusts.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1952 b, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الْجَرَادِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، وَإِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، وَابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، جَمِيعًا عَنِ ابْنِ عُيَيْنَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏ قَالَ أَبُو بَكْرٍ فِي رِوَايَتِهِ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ وَقَالَ إِسْحَاقُ سِتَّ وَقَالَ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ سِتَّ أَوْ سَبْعَ ‏.‏
en_text: And Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah, Ishaq ibn Ibrahim, and Ibn Abi 'Umar all narrated it from Ibn 'Uyaynah, from Abu Ya'fur, with this chain of transmission. Abu Bakr said in his narration: 'seven expeditions,' Ishaq said: 'six,' and Ibn Abi 'Umar said: 'six or seven.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1952 c, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الْجَرَادِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ أَبِي عَدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا ابْنُ بَشَّارٍ، عَنْ مُحَمَّدِ، بْنِ جَعْفَرٍ كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي يَعْفُورٍ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَقَالَ سَبْعَ غَزَوَاتٍ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated it to us: Ibn Abi 'Adi narrated to us; (Second Chain) and Ibn Bashshar narrated to us, from Muhammad ibn Ja'far; both of them from Shu'bah, from Abu Ya'fur, with this chain of transmission, and he said: 'seven expeditions.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1953 a, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الأَرْنَبِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ هِشَامِ بْنِ زَيْدٍ، عَنْ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ، قَالَ مَرَرْنَا فَاسْتَنْفَجْنَا أَرْنَبًا بِمَرِّ الظَّهْرَانِ فَسَعَوْا عَلَيْهِ فَلَغَبُوا ‏.‏ قَالَ فَسَعَيْتُ حَتَّى أَدْرَكْتُهَا فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا أَبَا طَلْحَةَ فَذَبَحَهَا فَبَعَثَ بِوَرِكِهَا وَفَخِذَيْهَا إِلَى رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَأَتَيْتُ بِهَا رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم فَقَبِلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Hisham ibn Zayd, from Anas ibn Malik, who said: We were passing by Marr az-Zahran and startled a hare. They chased it until they grew exhausted. He said: Then I ran until I caught it, and brought it to Abu Talhah, who slaughtered it and sent its haunch and its two thighs to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). So I brought them to the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace), and he accepted it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1953 b, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ الأَرْنَبِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدٌ، - يَعْنِي ابْنَ الْحَارِثِ - كِلاَهُمَا عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ وَفِي حَدِيثِ يَحْيَى بِوَرِكِهَا أَوْ فَخِذَيْهَا ‏.‏
en_text: And Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated it to me: Yahya ibn Sa'id narrated to us; (Second Chain) and Yahya ibn Habib narrated to me: Khalid—meaning Ibn al-Harith—narrated to us; both of them from Shu'bah, with this chain of transmission; and in the hadith of Yahya: 'with its haunch or its two thighs.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1954 a, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ مَا يُسْتَعَانُ بِهِ عَلَى الاِصْطِيَادِ وَالْعَدُوِّ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْخَذْفِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ الْعَنْبَرِيُّ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا كَهْمَسٌ، عَنِ ابْنِ بُرَيْدَةَ، قَالَ رَأَى عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ الْمُغَفَّلِ رَجُلاً مِنْ أَصْحَابِهِ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ لاَ تَخْذِفْ فَإِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَكْرَهُ - أَوْ قَالَ - يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ فَإِنَّهُ لاَ يُصْطَادُ بِهِ الصَّيْدُ وَلاَ يُنْكَأُ بِهِ الْعَدُوُّ وَلَكِنَّهُ يَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَيَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏.‏ ثُمَّ رَآهُ بَعْدَ ذَلِكَ يَخْذِفُ فَقَالَ لَهُ أُخْبِرُكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم كَانَ يَكْرَهُ أَوْ يَنْهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ ثُمَّ أَرَاكَ تَخْذِفُ لاَ أُكَلِّمُكَ كَلِمَةً كَذَا وَكَذَا ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh al-'Anbari narrated to us: my father narrated to us: Kahmas narrated to us, from Ibn Buraydah, who said: 'Abdullah ibn al-Mughaffal saw a man from his companions flicking pebbles, so he said to him: 'Do not flick pebbles, for the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) disliked—or he said: forbade—flicking pebbles; for game cannot be hunted with it, nor can an enemy be injured by it, but it breaks a tooth and puts out an eye.' Then he saw him flicking pebbles after that, so he said to him: 'I inform you that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) disliked or forbade flicking pebbles, and then I see you flicking pebbles? I will not speak a word to you for such-and-such a time!'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1954 b, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ مَا يُسْتَعَانُ بِهِ عَلَى الاِصْطِيَادِ وَالْعَدُوِّ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْخَذْفِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنِي أَبُو دَاوُدَ، سُلَيْمَانُ بْنُ مَعْبَدٍ حَدَّثَنَا عُثْمَانُ بْنُ عُمَرَ، أَخْبَرَنَا كَهْمَسٌ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Dawud Sulayman ibn Ma'bad narrated to me: 'Uthman ibn 'Umar narrated to us: Kahmas reported to us with this chain of transmission something similar to it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1954 c, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ مَا يُسْتَعَانُ بِهِ عَلَى الاِصْطِيَادِ وَالْعَدُوِّ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْخَذْفِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ قَتَادَةَ، عَنْ عُقْبَةَ بْنِ صُهْبَانَ، عَنْ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ، قَالَ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم عَنِ الْخَذْفِ ‏.‏ قَالَ ابْنُ جَعْفَرٍ فِي حَدِيثِهِ وَقَالَ إِنَّهُ لاَ يَنْكَأُ الْعَدُوَّ وَلاَ يَقْتُلُ الصَّيْدَ وَلَكِنَّهُ يَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَيَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏.‏ وَقَالَ ابْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ إِنَّهَا لاَ تَنْكَأُ الْعَدُوَّ ‏.‏ وَلَمْ يَذْكُرْ تَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far and 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us, saying: Shu'bah narrated to us, from Qatadah, from 'Uqbah ibn Suhban, from 'Abdullah ibn Mughaffal, who said: The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade flicking pebbles. Ibn Ja'far said in his narration: And he said: 'It does not inflict injury on an enemy, nor does it kill game, but it breaks a tooth and puts out an eye.' And Ibn Mahdi said: 'It does not inflict injury on an enemy,' and he did not mention: 'and puts out an eye.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1954 d, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ مَا يُسْتَعَانُ بِهِ عَلَى الاِصْطِيَادِ وَالْعَدُوِّ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْخَذْفِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ، بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ أَنَّ قَرِيبًا، لِعَبْدِ اللَّهِ بْنِ مُغَفَّلٍ خَذَفَ - قَالَ - فَنَهَاهُ وَقَالَ إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنِ الْخَذْفِ وَقَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّهَا لاَ تَصِيدُ صَيْدًا وَلاَ تَنْكَأُ عَدُوًّا وَلَكِنَّهَا تَكْسِرُ السِّنَّ وَتَفْقَأُ الْعَيْنَ ‏"‏ ‏.‏ قَالَ فَعَادَ ‏.‏ فَقَالَ أُحَدِّثُكَ أَنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم نَهَى عَنْهُ ثُمَّ تَخْذِفُ لاَ أُكَلِّمُكَ أَبَدًا ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Isma'il ibn 'Ulayyah narrated to us, from Ayyub, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr: that a relative of 'Abdullah ibn Mughaffal flicked pebbles (with his fingers). He said: So he forbade him and said: Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade flicking pebbles, saying: 'It does not hunt game, nor does it inflict injury on an enemy, but it breaks a tooth and puts out an eye.' He said: Then he did it again. So he said: 'I tell you that the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade it, and then you flick pebbles? I will never speak to you again!'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1954 e, book 34, باب إِبَاحَةِ مَا يُسْتَعَانُ بِهِ عَلَى الاِصْطِيَادِ وَالْعَدُوِّ وَكَرَاهَةِ الْخَذْفِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ ابْنُ أَبِي عُمَرَ، حَدَّثَنَا الثَّقَفِيُّ، عَنْ أَيُّوبَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ نَحْوَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Ibn Abi 'Umar narrated it to us: ath-Thaqafi narrated to us, from Ayyub, with this chain of transmission, something similar to it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1955 a, book 34, باب الأَمْرِ بِإِحْسَانِ الذَّبْحِ وَالْقَتْلِ وَتَحْدِيدِ الشَّفْرَةِ ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ أَبِي شَيْبَةَ، حَدَّثَنَا إِسْمَاعِيلُ ابْنُ عُلَيَّةَ، عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، عَنْ أَبِي قِلاَبَةَ، عَنْ أَبِي الأَشْعَثِ، عَنْ شَدَّادِ بْنِ أَوْسٍ، قَالَ ثِنْتَانِ حَفِظْتُهُمَا عَنْ رَسُولِ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ إِنَّ اللَّهَ كَتَبَ الإِحْسَانَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَىْءٍ فَإِذَا قَتَلْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الْقِتْلَةَ وَإِذَا ذَبَحْتُمْ فَأَحْسِنُوا الذَّبْحَ وَلْيُحِدَّ أَحَدُكُمْ شَفْرَتَهُ فَلْيُرِحْ ذَبِيحَتَهُ ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: Abu Bakr ibn Abi Shaybah narrated to us: Isma'il ibn 'Ulayyah narrated to us, from Khalid al-Hadhdha', from Abu Qilabah, from Abu al-Ash'ath, from Shaddad ibn Aws, who said: There are two things I memorized from the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace). He said: 'Indeed, Allah has prescribed excellence in all things. So when you kill, kill well; and when you slaughter, slaughter well. Let each one of you sharpen his blade and let him give ease to his slaughtered animal.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1955 b, book 34, باب الأَمْرِ بِإِحْسَانِ الذَّبْحِ وَالْقَتْلِ وَتَحْدِيدِ الشَّفْرَةِ ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ يَحْيَى بْنُ يَحْيَى، حَدَّثَنَا هُشَيْمٌ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ، أَخْبَرَنَا عَبْدُ الْوَهَّابِ الثَّقَفِيُّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو بَكْرِ بْنُ نَافِعٍ، حَدَّثَنَا غُنْدَرٌ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا عَبْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ عَبْدِ الرَّحْمَنِ الدَّارِمِيُّ، أَخْبَرَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ يُوسُفَ، عَنْ سُفْيَانَ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا إِسْحَاقُ، بْنُ إِبْرَاهِيمَ أَخْبَرَنَا جَرِيرٌ، عَنْ مَنْصُورٍ، كُلُّ هَؤُلاَءِ عَنْ خَالِدٍ الْحَذَّاءِ، بِإِسْنَادِ حَدِيثِ ابْنِ عُلَيَّةَ وَمَعْنَى حَدِيثِهِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Yahya ibn Yahya narrated it to us: Hushaym narrated to us; (Second Chain) and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: 'Abd al-Wahhab ath-Thaqafi reported to us; (Third Chain) and Abu Bakr ibn Nafi' narrated to us: Ghundar narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us; (Fourth Chain) and 'Abdullah ibn 'Abd ar-Rahman ad-Darimi narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Yusuf reported to us, from Sufyan; (Fifth Chain) and Ishaq ibn Ibrahim narrated to us: Jarir reported to us, from Mansur; all of them from Khalid al-Hadhdha', with the chain of transmission of the hadith of Ibn 'Ulayyah and the meaning of his hadith.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1956 a, book 34, باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ صَبْرِ الْبَهَائِمِ، ‏‏
text_original: حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ الْمُثَنَّى، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، قَالَ سَمِعْتُ هِشَامَ، بْنَ زَيْدِ بْنِ أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ قَالَ دَخَلْتُ مَعَ جَدِّي أَنَسِ بْنِ مَالِكٍ دَارَ الْحَكَمِ بْنِ أَيُّوبَ فَإِذَا قَوْمٌ قَدْ نَصَبُوا دَجَاجَةً يَرْمُونَهَا قَالَ فَقَالَ أَنَسٌ نَهَى رَسُولُ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم أَنْ تُصْبَرَ الْبَهَائِمُ ‏.‏
en_text: Muhammad ibn al-Muthanna narrated to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, saying: I heard Hisham ibn Zayd ibn Anas ibn Malik say: I entered the house of al-Hakam ibn Ayyub along with my grandfather Anas ibn Malik, and there were people who had tied up a hen and were shooting at it. He said: So Anas said: 'The Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) forbade that animals be tied up and killed (sabran).'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1956 b, book 34, باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ صَبْرِ الْبَهَائِمِ، ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنِيهِ زُهَيْرُ بْنُ حَرْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا يَحْيَى بْنُ سَعِيدٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، ح وَحَدَّثَنِي يَحْيَى بْنُ حَبِيبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا خَالِدُ بْنُ الْحَارِثِ، ح وَحَدَّثَنَا أَبُو كُرَيْبٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو أُسَامَةَ، كُلُّهُمْ عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ ‏.‏
en_text: And Zuhayr ibn Harb narrated it to me: Yahya ibn Sa'id and 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us; (Second Chain) and Yahya ibn Habib narrated to me: Khalid ibn al-Harith narrated to us; (Third Chain) and Abu Kuraib narrated to us: Abu Usamah narrated to us; all of them from Shu'bah, with this chain of transmission.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1957 a, book 34, باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ صَبْرِ الْبَهَائِمِ، ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا عُبَيْدُ اللَّهِ بْنُ مُعَاذٍ، حَدَّثَنَا أَبِي، حَدَّثَنَا شُعْبَةُ، عَنْ عَدِيٍّ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، عَنِ ابْنِ عَبَّاسٍ، أَنَّ النَّبِيَّ صلى الله عليه وسلم قَالَ ‏"‏ لاَ تَتَّخِذُوا شَيْئًا فِيهِ الرُّوحُ غَرَضًا ‏"‏ ‏.‏
en_text: 'Ubaydullah ibn Mu'adh narrated to us: my father narrated to us: Shu'bah narrated to us, from 'Adi, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, from Ibn 'Abbas, that the Prophet (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) said: 'Do not take anything possessing a soul as a target.'

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1957 b, book 34, باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ صَبْرِ الْبَهَائِمِ، ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَاهُ مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ بَشَّارٍ، حَدَّثَنَا مُحَمَّدُ بْنُ جَعْفَرٍ، وَعَبْدُ الرَّحْمَنِ بْنُ مَهْدِيٍّ، عَنْ شُعْبَةَ، بِهَذَا الإِسْنَادِ مِثْلَهُ ‏.‏
en_text: And Muhammad ibn Bashshar narrated it to us: Muhammad ibn Ja'far and 'Abd ar-Rahman ibn Mahdi narrated to us, from Shu'bah, with this chain of transmission, the like of it.

reference: Sahih Muslim, hadith 1958 a, book 34, باب النَّهْىِ عَنْ صَبْرِ الْبَهَائِمِ، ‏‏
text_original: وَحَدَّثَنَا شَيْبَانُ بْنُ فَرُّوخَ، وَأَبُو كَامِلٍ - وَاللَّفْظُ لأَبِي كَامِلٍ - قَالاَ حَدَّثَنَا أَبُو عَوَانَةَ عَنْ أَبِي بِشْرٍ، عَنْ سَعِيدِ بْنِ جُبَيْرٍ، قَالَ مَرَّ ابْنُ عُمَرَ بِنَفَرٍ قَدْ نَصَبُوا دَجَاجَةً يَتَرَامَوْنَهَا فَلَمَّا رَأَوُا ابْنَ عُمَرَ تَفَرَّقُوا عَنْهَا ‏.‏ فَقَالَ ابْنُ عُمَرَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا إِنَّ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صلى الله عليه وسلم لَعَنَ مَنْ فَعَلَ هَذَا ‏.‏
en_text: Shayban ibn Farrukh and Abu Kamil—and the wording is that of Abu Kamil—narrated to us, saying: Abu 'Awanah narrated to us, from Abu Bishr, from Sa'id ibn Jubayr, who said: Ibn 'Umar passed by a group of people who had set up a hen and were shooting arrows at it. When they saw Ibn 'Umar, they dispersed away from it. Ibn 'Umar said: 'Who did this? Indeed, the Messenger of Allah (may Allah bless him and grant him peace) cursed whoever did this.'
